show.description: A mischievous yet kind-hearted magician, Veer, is forced into a marriage with wheelchair-bound CEO Shaifali due to family greed and betrayal. Surrounded by poison plots, conspiracies, and public humiliation, he secretly becomes her invisible shield. In a world built to break them, love becomes their most dangerous secret.
